title: Low-Carb Goat Cheese Burekitas
subtitle: with an almond flour cheese dough
description: Low-carb triangles with a dough of melted yellow cheese and almond flour, filled with slices of goat cheese and sprinkled with sesame.

steps.text: Melt the yellow cheese in the microwave for about 30 seconds and mix with the almond meal and salt into a dough. Roll out and cut into rounds.
Place a slice of goat cheese in the centre of each round and fold into a triangle. Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake in an oven or toaster oven at 160-170°C for about 15 minutes.
